findings.passage: “I am calling on Acting Secretary of State Chapman to listen to voters who have been disenfranchised, and secure election procedures in Pennsylvania.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name (House caucus release dated 5/5/2022) responding to the acting Secretary of State's concerns about a county plan to watch ballot drop boxes. Calls for secure election procedures.

findings.passage: Requiring voter ID, reporting election misconduct and other provisions contained in the seven election security bills I authored, would go a long way in providing election security in Pennsylvania.”
findings.note: Same statement. He names requiring voter ID and reporting election misconduct as part of seven election security bills he says he authored.
